purpose: Close only the NL0C/Y contribution to the mixed-H4 spatial Ward numerical budget by combining the already-frozen zero-background/zero-linear-Euler structure with the exact Stage-E mixed source row support. The physical H4 Y u/phi source remains present. No full Ward residual is read.
